audit_status.source_base: Greek Acts text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for Peter's Jerusalem explanation, no distinction, Gentile turning to life, Antioch community, Barnabas/Saul, Christian naming, Agabus famine relief.

verses.restored: The apostles and the siblings throughout Judea heard that the nations also received the word of the Divine.

familiar.text: And the apostles and brethren that were in Judaea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.

modern.text: The apostles and brothers throughout Judea soon heard that the Gentiles also had received the word of God.

original.text: Ἤκουσαν δὲ οἱ ἀπόστολοι καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ οἱ ὄντες κατὰ τὴν Ἰουδαίαν ὅτι καὶ τὰ ἔθνη ἐδέξαντο τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ.

verses.restored: When Peter went up to Jerusalem, those from circumcision were disputing with him,

familiar.text: And when Peter was come up to Jerusalem, they that were of the circumcision contended with him,

modern.text: So when Peter went up to Jerusalem, the circumcised believers took issue with him

original.text: ⸂ὅτε δὲ⸃ ἀνέβη Πέτρος εἰς ⸀Ἰερουσαλήμ, διεκρίνοντο πρὸς αὐτὸν οἱ ἐκ περιτομῆς

verses.restored: saying, You went in to men having uncircumcision and ate with them.

familiar.text: Saying, Thou wentest in to men uncircumcised, and didst eat with them.

modern.text: and said, “You visited uncircumcised men and ate with them.”

original.text: λέγοντες ὅτι ⸂Εἰσῆλθες πρὸς ἄνδρας ἀκροβυστίαν ἔχοντας καὶ συνέφαγες⸃ αὐτοῖς.

verses.restored: Peter began and explained to them in order, saying,

familiar.text: But Peter rehearsed the matter from the beginning, and expounded it by order unto them, saying,

modern.text: But Peter began and explained to them the whole sequence of events:

original.text: ἀρξάμενος ⸀δὲ Πέτρος ἐξετίθετο αὐτοῖς καθεξῆς λέγων·

verses.restored: I was in the city of Joppa praying, and in a trance I saw a vision: a certain vessel descending like a great linen sheet, being lowered from heaven by four corners, and it came to me.

familiar.text: I was in the city of Joppa praying: and in a trance I saw a vision, A certain vessel descend, as it had been a great sheet, let down from heaven by four corners; and it came even to me:

modern.text: “I was in the city of Joppa praying, and in a trance I saw a vision of something like a large sheet being let down from heaven by its four corners, and it came right down to me.

original.text: Ἐγὼ ἤμην ἐν πόλει Ἰόππῃ προσευχόμενος καὶ εἶδον ἐν ἐκστάσει ὅραμα, καταβαῖνον σκεῦός τι ὡς ὀθόνην μεγάλην τέσσαρσιν ἀρχαῖς καθιεμένην ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ, καὶ ἦλθεν ἄχρι ἐμοῦ·

verses.restored: Looking intently into it, I observed and saw the four-footed creatures of the earth, wild beasts, reptiles, and birds of heaven.

familiar.text: Upon the which when I had fastened mine eyes, I considered, and saw fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.

modern.text: I looked at it closely and saw four-footed animals of the earth, wild beasts, reptiles, and birds of the air.

original.text: εἰς ἣν ἀτενίσας κατενόουν καὶ εἶδον τὰ τετράποδα τῆς γῆς καὶ τὰ θηρία καὶ τὰ ἑρπετὰ καὶ τὰ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ·

verses.restored: I also heard a voice saying to me, Rise, Peter; slaughter and eat.

familiar.text: And I heard a voice saying unto me, Arise, Peter; slay and eat.

modern.text: Then I heard a voice saying to me, ‘Get up, Peter, kill and eat.’

original.text: ἤκουσα δὲ ⸀καὶ φωνῆς λεγούσης μοι· Ἀναστάς, Πέτρε, θῦσον καὶ φάγε.

verses.restored: But I said, By no means, Lord, because common or unclean has never entered into my mouth.

familiar.text: But I said, Not so, Lord: for nothing common or unclean hath at any time entered into my mouth.

modern.text: ‘No, Lord,’ I said, ‘for nothing impure or unclean has ever entered my mouth.’

original.text: εἶπον δέ· Μηδαμῶς, κύριε, ⸀ὅτι κοινὸν ἢ ἀκάθαρτον οὐδέποτε εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὸ στόμα μου.

verses.restored: A voice answered a second time from heaven, What the Divine cleansed, you must not make common.

familiar.text: But the voice answered me again from heaven, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.

modern.text: But the voice spoke from heaven a second time, ‘Do not call anything impure that God has made clean.’

original.text: ἀπεκρίθη δὲ ⸂φωνὴ ἐκ δευτέρου⸃ ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ· Ἃ ὁ θεὸς ἐκαθάρισεν σὺ μὴ κοίνου.

verses.restored: This happened three times, and all was drawn up again into heaven.

familiar.text: And this was done three times: and all were drawn up again into heaven.

modern.text: This happened three times, and everything was drawn back up into heaven.

original.text: τοῦτο δὲ ἐγένετο ἐπὶ τρίς, καὶ ⸂ἀνεσπάσθη πάλιν⸃ ἅπαντα εἰς τὸν οὐρανόν.

verses.restored: Look, immediately three men stood at the house in which we were, having been sent to me from Caesarea.

familiar.text: And, behold, immediately there were three men already come unto the house where I was, sent from Caesarea unto me.

modern.text: Just then three men sent to me from Caesarea stopped at the house where I was staying.

original.text: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐξαυτῆς τρεῖς ἄνδρες ἐπέστησαν ἐπὶ τὴν οἰκίαν ἐν ᾗ ⸀ἦμεν, ἀπεσταλμένοι ἀπὸ Καισαρείας πρός με.

verses.restored: The Spirit told me to go with them, making no distinction. These six siblings also came with me, and we entered into the man's house.

familiar.text: And the Spirit bade me go with them, nothing doubting. Moreover these six brethren accompanied me, and we entered into the man’s house:

modern.text: The Spirit told me to accompany them without hesitation. These six brothers also went with me, and we entered the man’s home.

original.text: εἶπεν δὲ ⸂τὸ πνεῦμά μοι⸃ συνελθεῖν αὐτοῖς μηδὲν ⸀διακρίναντα. ἦλθον δὲ σὺν ἐμοὶ καὶ οἱ ἓξ ἀδελφοὶ οὗτοι, καὶ εἰσήλθομεν εἰς τὸν οἶκον τοῦ ἀνδρός.

verses.restored: He reported to us how he saw the messenger standing in his house and saying, Send to Joppa and summon Simon called Peter,

familiar.text: And he shewed us how he had seen an angel in his house, which stood and said unto him, Send men to Joppa, and call for Simon, whose surname is Peter;

modern.text: He told us how he had seen an angel standing in his house and saying, ‘Send to Joppa for Simon who is called Peter.

original.text: ἀπήγγειλεν ⸀δὲ ἡμῖν πῶς εἶδεν τὸν ἄγγελον ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ αὐτοῦ σταθέντα καὶ ⸀εἰπόντα· Ἀπόστειλον εἰς ⸀Ἰόππην καὶ μετάπεμψαι Σίμωνα τὸν ἐπικαλούμενον Πέτρον,

verses.restored: who will speak words to you by which you will be saved/healed, you and all your house.

familiar.text: Who shall tell thee words, whereby thou and all thy house shall be saved.

modern.text: He will convey to you a message by which you and all your household will be saved.’

original.text: ὃς λαλήσει ῥήματα πρὸς σὲ ἐν οἷς σωθήσῃ σὺ καὶ πᾶς ὁ οἶκός σου.

verses.restored: As I began to speak, the holy Spirit fell upon them just as also upon us at the beginning.

familiar.text: And as I began to speak, the Holy Ghost fell on them, as on us at the beginning.

modern.text: As I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell upon them, just as He had fallen upon us at the beginning.

original.text: ἐν δὲ τῷ ἄρξασθαί με λαλεῖν ἐπέπεσεν τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον ἐπʼ αὐτοὺς ὥσπερ καὶ ἐφʼ ἡμᾶς ἐν ἀρχῇ.

verses.restored: I remembered the word of the Lord, how he said, John baptized in water, but you will be baptized in holy Spirit.

familiar.text: Then remembered I the word of the Lord, how that he said, John indeed baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost.

modern.text: Then I remembered the word of the Lord, as He used to say, ‘John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.’

original.text: ἐμνήσθην δὲ τοῦ ῥήματος ⸀τοῦ κυρίου ὡς ἔλεγεν· Ἰωάννης μὲν ἐβάπτισεν ὕδατι, ὑμεῖς δὲ βαπτισθήσεσθε ἐν πνεύματι ἁγίῳ.

verses.restored: If therefore the Divine gave them the equal gift as also to us when we trusted upon the Lord Jesus Messiah, who was I to be able to hinder the Divine?

familiar.text: Forasmuch then as God gave them the like gift as he did unto us, who believed on the Lord Jesus Christ; what was I, that I could withstand God?

modern.text: So if God gave them the same gift He gave us who believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I to hinder the work of God?”

original.text: εἰ οὖν τὴν ἴσην δωρεὰν ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς ὁ θεὸς ὡς καὶ ἡμῖν πιστεύσασιν ἐπὶ τὸν κύριον Ἰησοῦν Χριστόν, ⸀ἐγὼ τίς ἤμην δυνατὸς κωλῦσαι τὸν θεόν;

verses.restored: Hearing these things, they became quiet and glorified the Divine, saying, Then to the nations also the Divine has given turning/realignment into life.

familiar.text: When they heard these things, they held their peace, and glorified God, saying, Then hath God also to the Gentiles granted repentance unto life.

modern.text: When they heard this, their objections were put to rest, and they glorified God, saying, “So then, God has granted even the Gentiles repentance unto life.” The Church at Antioch

original.text: ἀκούσαντες δὲ ταῦτα ἡσύχασαν καὶ ⸀ἐδόξασαν τὸν θεὸν λέγοντες· ⸀Ἄρα καὶ τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ὁ θεὸς τὴν μετάνοιαν ⸂εἰς ζωὴν ἔδωκεν⸃.

verses.restored: Now those scattered from the pressure that happened over Stephen traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, speaking the word to no one except Judeans only.

familiar.text: Now they which were scattered abroad upon the persecution that arose about Stephen travelled as far as Phenice, and Cyprus, and Antioch, preaching the word to none but unto the Jews only.

modern.text: Meanwhile those scattered by the persecution that began with Stephen traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, speaking the message only to Jews.

original.text: Οἱ μὲν οὖν διασπαρέντες ἀπὸ τῆς θλίψεως τῆς γενομένης ἐπὶ Στεφάνῳ διῆλθον ἕως Φοινίκης καὶ Κύπρου καὶ Ἀντιοχείας μηδενὶ λαλοῦντες τὸν λόγον εἰ μὴ μόνον Ἰουδαίοις.

verses.restored: But there were some of them, men of Cyprus and Cyrene, who came to Antioch and were speaking also to the Greeks, announcing the good news of the Lord Jesus.

familiar.text: And some of them were men of Cyprus and Cyrene, which, when they were come to Antioch, spake unto the Grecians, preaching the LORD Jesus.

modern.text: But some of them, men from Cyprus and Cyrene, went to Antioch and began speaking to the Greeks as well, proclaiming the good news about the Lord Jesus.

original.text: ἦσαν δέ τινες ἐξ αὐτῶν ἄνδρες Κύπριοι καὶ Κυρηναῖοι, οἵτινες ⸀ἐλθόντες εἰς Ἀντιόχειαν ἐλάλουν ⸀καὶ πρὸς τοὺς ⸀Ἑλληνιστάς, εὐαγγελιζόμενοι τὸν κύριον Ἰησοῦν.

verses.restored: The hand of the Lord was with them, and a great number, trusting, turned to the Lord.

familiar.text: And the hand of the Lord was with them: and a great number believed, and turned unto the Lord.

modern.text: The hand of the Lord was with them, and a great number of people believed and turned to the Lord.

original.text: καὶ ἦν χεὶρ κυρίου μετʼ αὐτῶν, πολύς τε ἀριθμὸς ⸀ὁ πιστεύσας ἐπέστρεψεν ἐπὶ τὸν κύριον.

verses.restored: The word about them was heard in the ears of the assembly in Jerusalem, and they sent out Barnabas as far as Antioch.

familiar.text: Then tidings of these things came unto the ears of the church which was in Jerusalem: and they sent forth Barnabas, that he should go as far as Antioch.

modern.text: When news of this reached the ears of the church in Jerusalem, they sent Barnabas to Antioch.

original.text: ἠκούσθη δὲ ὁ λόγος εἰς τὰ ὦτα τῆς ἐκκλησίας τῆς ⸀οὔσης ἐν ⸀Ἰερουσαλὴμ περὶ αὐτῶν, καὶ ἐξαπέστειλαν ⸀Βαρναβᾶν ἕως Ἀντιοχείας·

verses.restored: When he came and saw the grace of the Divine, he rejoiced and encouraged all to remain with the Lord with purpose of heart.

familiar.text: Who, when he came, and had seen the grace of God, was glad, and exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they would cleave unto the Lord.

modern.text: When he arrived and saw the grace of God, he rejoiced and encouraged them all to abide in the Lord with all their hearts.

original.text: ὃς παραγενόμενος καὶ ἰδὼν τὴν χάριν ⸀τὴν τοῦ θεοῦ, ἐχάρη καὶ παρεκάλει πάντας τῇ προθέσει τῆς καρδίας ⸀προσμένειν τῷ κυρίῳ,

verses.restored: For he was a good man and full of holy Spirit and trust; and a considerable crowd was added to the Lord.

familiar.text: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Ghost and of faith: and much people was added unto the Lord.

modern.text: Barnabas was a good man, full of the Holy Spirit and faith, and a great number of people were brought to the Lord.

original.text: ὅτι ἦν ἀνὴρ ἀγαθὸς καὶ πλήρης πνεύματος ἁγίου καὶ πίστεως. καὶ προσετέθη ὄχλος ἱκανὸς τῷ κυρίῳ.

verses.restored: He went out to Tarsus to seek Saul.

familiar.text: Then departed Barnabas to Tarsus, for to seek Saul:

modern.text: Then Barnabas went to Tarsus to look for Saul,

original.text: ἐξῆλθεν δὲ εἰς ⸀Ταρσὸν ἀναζητῆσαι Σαῦλον,

verses.restored: Finding him, he brought him to Antioch. It happened that for a whole year they were gathered in the assembly and taught a considerable crowd, and in Antioch the disciples were first called Christians.

familiar.text: And when he had found him, he brought him unto Antioch. And it came to pass, that a whole year they assembled themselves with the church, and taught much people. And the disciples were called Christians first in Antioch.

modern.text: and when he found him, he brought him back to Antioch. So for a full year they met together with the church and taught large numbers of people. The disciples were first called Christians at Antioch.

original.text: καὶ εὑρὼν ⸀ἤγαγεν εἰς Ἀντιόχειαν. ἐγένετο δὲ ⸂αὐτοῖς καὶ⸃ ἐνιαυτὸν ὅλον συναχθῆναι ⸀ἐν τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ καὶ διδάξαι ὄχλον ἱκανόν, χρηματίσαι τε ⸀πρώτως ἐν Ἀντιοχείᾳ τοὺς μαθητὰς Χριστιανούς.

verses.restored: In these days prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.

familiar.text: And in these days came prophets from Jerusalem unto Antioch.

modern.text: In those days some prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.

original.text: Ἐν ταύταις δὲ ταῖς ἡμέραις κατῆλθον ἀπὸ Ἱεροσολύμων προφῆται εἰς Ἀντιόχειαν·

verses.restored: One from them named Agabus stood up and signified through the Spirit that a great famine was about to be over the whole inhabited world, which happened under Claudius.

familiar.text: And there stood up one of them named Agabus, and signified by the Spirit that there should be great dearth throughout all the world: which came to pass in the days of Claudius Caesar.

modern.text: One of them named Agabus stood up and predicted through the Spirit that a great famine would sweep across the whole world. (This happened under Claudius.)

original.text: ἀναστὰς δὲ εἷς ἐξ αὐτῶν ὀνόματι Ἅγαβος ἐσήμανεν διὰ τοῦ πνεύματος λιμὸν ⸀μεγάλην μέλλειν ἔσεσθαι ἐφʼ ὅλην τὴν οἰκουμένην· ⸀ἥτις ἐγένετο ἐπὶ ⸀Κλαυδίου.

verses.restored: According as any of the disciples had means, each determined to send service to the siblings dwelling in Judea.

familiar.text: Then the disciples, every man according to his ability, determined to send relief unto the brethren which dwelt in Judaea:

modern.text: So the disciples, each according to his ability, decided to send relief to the brothers living in Judea.

original.text: τῶν δὲ μαθητῶν καθὼς εὐπορεῖτό τις ὥρισαν ἕκαστος αὐτῶν εἰς διακονίαν πέμψαι τοῖς κατοικοῦσιν ἐν τῇ Ἰουδαίᾳ ἀδελφοῖς·

verses.restored: They did this, sending it to the elders by the hand of Barnabas and Saul.

familiar.text: Which also they did, and sent it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.

modern.text: This they did, sending their gifts to the elders with Barnabas and Saul.

original.text: ὃ καὶ ἐποίησαν ἀποστείλαντες πρὸς τοὺς πρεσβυτέρους διὰ χειρὸς Βαρναβᾶ καὶ Σαύλου.
